name: Stepfamilies
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sanctity and unity of the family as established in marriage, where a man leaves his parents to become one flesh with his wife (Genesis 2:24). Honoring parents remains a vital commandment (Exodus 20:12), reflecting the importance of respect within family relationships. The choice to serve the Lord as a household (Joshua 24:15) underscores the spiritual foundation necessary for family life. Wisdom in nurturing and maintaining a virtuous and peaceful household is encouraged, warning against causing trouble within one's own home (Proverbs 1:8; 11:29; 12:4). Together, these passages guide stepfamilies to uphold biblical principles of unity, honor, and godly leadership.
